title: Correcting a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plan Redemption Recorded in Error
content:
Under the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, a redemption recorded in error is reversed and its visit returned to the plan. A redemption is recorded in error when the service was not performed, or when the work was paid by a recall, warranty or factory complimentary maintenance coverage.

## Terms of a reinstatement
- **Window.** A redemption is reinstated only within the plan's reinstatement window, counted in calendar days after its entry date. The entry date is day 0, and reinstatement is possible through the last day of the window. The window is judged on the redemption's entry date as the plan ledger records it.
- **Once only.** A redemption is reinstated at most once. A redemption that already carries a reinstatement is not reinstated again.
- **Closed plans.** A reinstatement on a plan that has since expired or been cancelled is not made. The visit is instead counted in the cancellation or expiry as unused.

## Window cases (hypothetical, 30-day window)

| Redemption entry date | Day of the request | Reinstated? |
|---|---|---|
| Day 0 | Day 30 | Yes: the last day of the window |
| Day 0 | Day 31 | No |
| Day 0, already reinstated once | Day 5 | No: at most once |
| Day 0, plan since cancelled | Day 10 | No: the visit counts as unused in the cancellation |

A reinstatement returns exactly one visit, the one taken by the redemption it reverses.
